vulns.title: Flawed overflow guard in math_utils allows near-free liquidity
vulns.root_cause: checked_shl_64 uses `n > overflow_mask` instead of checking whether any bit above position 191 is set; an attacker crafts sqrt-price bounds that trigger the precision fallback path, causing compute_deposit_a to return a near-zero required_a deposit, so add_liquidity mints a large liquidity position for almost no token A.
